items.alt: A white rabbit wearing a waistcoat stands upright consulting a pocket-watch.
Alice pulls back a curtain to reveal a small door. She holds a tiny key in her right hand.
Alice stands at a small table, holding a bottle labelled “Drink Me.”
Alice stands with arms raised in surprise, as she grows taller and her neck stretches out.
Alice kneels in a low corridor, watching a white rabbit hurry away.
Alice is swept off her feet by a flood of water which reaches over her shoulders.
Alice is swimming in a pool watching a mouse as big as herself swim away.
A large crowd of creatures stand around listening to a mouse. The creatures include an owl, a dodo, and a crab.
Alice accepts a humble handed to her by a dodo who is taller than herself. The dodo leans upon a stick.
A gigantic Alice is crammed inside a small room, her arm of the window.
Alice’s giant hand comes down from above. A white rabbit in a waistcoat has fallen back into a cucumber-frame.
A lizard is being shot upwards out of a smoking chimney.
A tiny Alice hesitantly proffers a stick to a puppy dog which is far larger than herself.
Alice peers over the edge of a mushroom as tall as herself to stare at an upright caterpillar smoking a hookah.
A young man in rural costume stares at an old fat man who is standing on his head.
A young man in rural costume backs away from a doorway as an old fat man somersaults through it.
A young man in rural costume lifts the covers from a empty plates and stares at a fat old man sitting by a fireplace.
A young man in rural costume stares in amazement at an old fat man who is balancing a wriggling eel on his nose.
A frog dressed as a footman stands in a pillared doorway accepting a huge envelope from a fish also dressed as a footman.
The interior of a kitchen. A servant stirs a pot on the stove while an ugly woman dressed as a duchess sits nursing a squalling baby.
Alice stands in a garden holding a pig in her arms as though it were a baby.
Alice stands with her hands clasped behind her, looking up at a grinning cat on the branch of a tree.
A cat on a tree-branch is fading away, leaving only its grin.
An outside table is set for tea. Alice sits at one end, looking cross. A hare and a hatter sit with a dormouse between them.
A hatter sits at a tea-table, singing. He seems to be elbowing a dormouse in the eye.
A hare and a hatter are stuffing a dormouse into the top of a teapot.
Three playing-cards with heads, arms and legs stand around a rose-tree arguing.
The King and Queen of Hearts, surrounded by courtiers, stand in a garden. The Queen points accusingly at Alice. At right, a servant holds a cushion bearing a large crown.
Alice stands with one foot on a hedgehog, holding on to a flamingo which stares her in the face.
A large cat’s head floats above a crowd which includes the King and Queen of Hearts.
Alice walks side-by-side with an ugly duchess. Alice is holding a flamingo under her arm.
A gryphon lies on the ground, asleep. It is a creature with the fore-parts of an eagle and the hind-parts of a lion.
A gryphon sits on the ground next to Alice. On a rock stands a turtle with the head of a calf, weeping.
A turtle with the head of a calf and a gryphon dance around Alice.
A lobster stands upright before a dressing-table, holding a hair-brush.
A white rabbit stands upright, dressed in livery patterned with hearts. With one hand he is blowing a small trumpet and holding a scroll in his other hand.
A hatter stands holding a cup of tea in one hand and a sandwich in the other. He is in his stockinged feet, with his shoes cast aside.
A hatter runs off to the right. He is holding a cup of tea and a sandwich.
Alice is in the process of standing up, and in doing so, upsetting a jury-box filled with small animals.
The King of Hearts is seated on a throne, wearing spectacles. Below him stands the Knave of Hearts and on a table is a plate of tarts.
Alice is standing, trying to fend off a cloud of playing-cards which swirl up around her. At her feet are many small animals.
